name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
June 12, 2012
6:00 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Grace Reasoner, Board Member of Vista Buddhist Temple
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring Thursday, June 28, 2012, "Ronald McDonald House Charities Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ended April 30, 2012 (CC)
C4.
Adoption of the FY 2012/2013 Appropriation Limit (CC)
C5.
CalRecycle Program Grants (CC)
C6.
CIP No. 8125 Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Sewer and Agua Hedionda Lift Station - State Revolving Fund Loan Authorizations (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , designating the City Manager as its authorized representative and authorizing the City Manager to submit financial assistance applications for the Clean Water State Revolving Fund Program to the State Water Resources Control Board;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving reimbursement of expenditures for Projects from State Water Resources Control Board Funds; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , pledging net revenue from Vista Sewer Operating Revenues for Clean Water State Revolving Fund Program of the State Water Resources Control Board.
C7.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Administration (CC)
C8.
Encina Wastewater Authority Budget for FY 2012/2013 (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- .
C9.
Agreements with VCMA, VCEA and VFFA, and Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan Amendments (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Letter of Agreement between the City of Vista and the Vista City Maintenance Association (VCMA); (Recommended Action continued on following page)
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Letter of Agreement between the City of Vista and the Vista City Employees Association (VCEA);
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving a Letter of Agreement between the City of Vista and the Vista Firefighters Association (VFFA); and
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Management and Confidential Employee Compensation Plan and repealing all resolutions in conflict herewith.
C10.
Fee Waiver for Operation HOPE (CC)
C11.
San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) 2012 Active Transportation Grant Program (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , authorizing the filing of an application for Active Transportation Grant Program funds through SANDAG for a Bicycle Master Plan, and accepting the terms of the grant agreement;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , authorizing the filing of an application for Active Transportation Grant Program funds through SANDAG for the S. Melrose Bike Lane Improvements Project, and accepting the terms of the grant agreement; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , authorizing the filing of an application for Active Transportation Grant Program funds through the SANDAG for the Longhorn Drive at S. Melrose Drive Sidewalk Enlargement Project, and accepting the terms of the grant agreement.
C12.
Vista Village Business Association (VVBA) Special Event Banner Signs (CC)
C13.
Vista Fire Protection District Supplemental Agreement (CC)
C14.
Woman's Club of Vista Donation (CC)
C15.
Lease Agreement with North County Lifeline - APN 175-135-01-00 (CC)
C16.
Water Quality Protection Program Support Services (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an as needed agreement with Mikhail Ogawa Engineering, Inc., for Water Quality Planning Support Services, and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an as needed agreement with Weston Solutions, Inc., for Water Quality Program Implementation Services, and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement.
C17.
FY 2012/2013 Operating Budget (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- ;
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- ; and
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- .
DISCUSSION
D1.
November 6, 2012, General Municipal Election (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , calling and giving notice that a General Municipal Election will be held on November 6, 2012, for the election of certain officers, and requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of San Diego to consolidate the November 6, 2012, General Municipal Election with the Statewide General Election to be held on the same date, pursuant to Section 10403 of the Elections Code; and
2.
If the City Council desires, adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , providing for the conduct of a Special Runoff Election in the event of a tie vote at the November 6, 2012, General Municipal Election.
D2.
Candidate Statement of Regulations for November 2012 Election (CC)
1.
Establish the maximum number of words, 200 or 400, to be permitted in a Candidate's Statement of Qualifications for the Office of Member of the City Council at the November 6, 2012, General Municipal Election; and
(Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , adopting regulations for candidates' statements to be submitted to the voters for the November 6, 2012, General Municipal Election.
D3.
Appointments to Various Commissions, Boards and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the annual appointments to various commissions, boards, and committees; and
2.
Appoint two members to the Planning Commission.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Regional Transportation Improvement Program 2012 Update (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing and receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2013 through 2017.
PH2.
Collection of Delinquent 2011 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to provide an opportunity for each owner of land or other interested person whose parcel is affected by the FY 2011/12 Report of Proceedings and an Account of Costs Incurred to present a written or oral protest or objection to such report and account, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving and confirming a report and account for abatement of weeds, shrubs, dead trees and waste matter for FY 2011/12.
PH3.
Levy of Assessments for FY 2012/2013 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1 for FY 2012/13;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for FY 2012/13; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , providing for the annual assessment levy of the South Melrose Drive Landscape Maintenance District for FY 2012/13.
PH4.
Collection of Delinquent Sewer Service Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- memorializing the sewer service charge for FY 2012/13 in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2008-4 and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2012/13 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , memorializing the sewer service charge for FY 2012/13 in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2008-1 and approving liens on assessor's parcels within the district to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2012/13 tax roll for unpaid sewer service charges.
PH5.
Levy of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges for FY 2011/2012 (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2012/13 property tax roll for delinquent refuse collection service fees and collection charges.
PH6.
Levy of Delinquent Property Related Administrative Citation Charges for FY 2011/2012 (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving liens on assessor's parcels within the City of Vista to be collected with the general property taxes on the FY 2012/13 property tax roll for delinquent property related administrative citations.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
